purpose: Codex's paid-review brief (docs/CODEX_V17_PAID_RENDER_REVIEW_20261012.md, item 5): test both sides. First, the revised quality question (dual release v3, object-joins/v1) must reject the saved broken New York image and keep passing coherent saved images. Then, and only if it does, three new New York paintings under release v18 (the taxi sign and roof restored from the board) must stay natural. Not authorized: it needs Guy's own spend approval, and it is a new run identity, never the completed v17 run's.

identity.rule: Reuse the v5 identity sheets bought on 12 October, byte for byte. Refuse to run if a sheet's SHA-256 differs.

qualification.rule: One Opus HIGH review per saved picture, with the v3 question, on the exact saved v17 shipping crop composed on the board through the product's evidence path. No painting is bought. Refuse to run if a saved picture's SHA-256 differs.

pictures.why: A new taxi sign joined to the original's lower half at the bottom join: lettering cut, doubled left edge. v17's Opus passed it.
Same hide, sign coherent and unchanged: the question must not reject a sound join on the same object.
Another hide with a replaced bystander and a coherently repainted toy: a coherent change must still pass.
Shortened sign: a coherent change by Guy's policy, with a long lower edge Codex flagged for scrutiny. Its verdict never gates; an unreadable or missing answer does, like any other.

qualification.gate: Paint nothing unless all four answers are readable and decided (Codex's v18 review, R2). B-a10: a retry whose normalized pictureWhole or severeSeam is fail with its own nonempty located fault (a failed boundary the reader turns into a located pictureWhole counts), derived and claimed verdict fail, and nothing downgraded, contradicted or unclassified; a retry for uncertainty alone never counts. Both controls: acceptable, with a claimed pass. A-a10: acceptable or retry, nothing softened. Unreadable or missing evidence stops the run before the paintings; every answer and charge is kept.

pass: Every new painting ships the board's own sign and roof: its receipt names the pinned outline, 10925 restored pixels, and the shipped image.
No new painting shows a second, ghost or partial sign outside the outline, and no shoe stands on top of the sign (eye, and both reviewers).
Both reviewers accept each new painting; a rejection of a natural painting is recorded as a false rejection of the v3 question, not hidden.
Identity, gender and hair as in the v17 paintings; the 10-year-olds visibly taller than the 6-year-old.
